name: character resources
normative-structure: Who holds what office is a readout of this office's personnel register, not a claim in prose that happens to be believed. It persists across incumbents because incumbency is a double settlement — recognition and induction — and a firm with no office keeping that settlement machine-readable has only prose's word for who is seated where, which is exactly the condition that let a character be recorded as First Officer with nothing to correct it. The office answers for the register matching reality, for the mutual-selection rule running in both directions where it applies, and for the three rights being recorded as delegated in full or not delegated at all — never as a partial grant that reads as full.
theory-basis: emsenn/term/office: incumbency is the double settlement of recognition (backward, history-sensitive) and induction (forward-committed); vacant is (bottom, bottom), dignitas is (t,t), and a top in either is a repair condition — this office keeps that settlement as a record rather than as an assumption

rendanheyi/sanquan: the three rights — decision, personnel, distribution — delegated in full constitute a unit as an enterprise; any two without the third produces a department every time regardless of what the unit is called, per lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/coesite-clearing/services/union-officer-academy/services/management-thought/rendanheyi/content/glossary/terms/sanquan.md

rendanheyi/guanbing-huxuan: selection running both ways — the unit's members choosing and removing their leader, not only the leader choosing them — is a personnel fact this office must be able to record in both directions
huidu-guanli/ipd: functional managers own capability-building and staffing while project leads appraise project work — the two are different offices, and this one is the first, not the second
unrealized: no personnel register exists yet — incumbency across the firm is presently prose's claim, checked by nobody, which is the exact condition that produced the fabricated First Officer attribution the requirement names

no unit has a recorded instance of guanbing-huxuan or the three rights held in full; sanquan and mutual selection are stated here as the standard this office answers to, not as anything yet true of any seated unit
the boundary between this office's staffing duty and a project lead's appraisal of project work is asserted from IPD and not yet tested against any firm project where the two could conflict
